name: establishment-crawler
description: Instagram reel crawler + reshaper (backend + frontend dev runner)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.setup: cd backend && uv sync && cd ../frontend && npm install
